title: 10 Best Bixa Orellana Preparations
intro: The best medicinal preparations of Bixa orellana are teas, decoctions, oils, tinctures, and juices, each offering unique therapeutic benefits. Teas made from the seeds or leaves are commonly used to aid digestion and reduce inflammation. Decoctions involve boiling the plant parts to extract potent compounds for treating skin conditions and respiratory issues. Oils derived from the seeds are applied topically for their antifungal and wound-healing properties. Tinctures and juices provide concentrated doses of the herb’s active compounds, often used for their antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
